answer: Membership in a coastal agent cooperative expires unless its human delegate attends a single simultaneous summit each epoch, starting at the published high tide. For 15 minutes, each person occupies one supervised booth and taps a fresh random sequence of ivory and black tiles; observers certify one key per body and compare booth logs. An extra rewarded key therefore needs another person for that whole window. This prices aliases in hired attendance; corrupt observers and remote members' travel costs limit the scheme.
